title: Holiday Shopping ‘Buy Now Pay Later’ Options May Put Some Consumers At Risk
summary: A local TV segment warns holiday shoppers about BNPL's hidden interest and refund troubles.

assertions.quote: CONSUMER REPORTS CALLING FOR FEDERAL PROTECTIONS, ARGUING MANY BNPL PROGRAMS CARRY INTEREST
SHOPPERS OFTEN HAVE TROUBLE GETTING REFUNDS EVEN IF THE ITEM IS DAMAGED OR NEVER ARRIVED
YOUNGER CONSUMERS ESPECIALLY WHO PARTICIPATE IN BNPL PROGRAMS ARE THE MOST LIKELY TO FALL INTO DEBT OR MISS A PAYMENT

verdicts.note: Consistent with data showing higher delinquency among younger, often lower-income BNPL users, though the comparison group isn't always specified.

assertions.quote: YOU NEVER KNOW WHAT MIGHT HAPPEN BETWEEN BUYING THAT ONE LUMP SUM THING. THEN YOU MIGHT COME ACROSS A HARDSHIP

verdicts.note: Splitting a purchase doesn't remove the obligation to pay; a hardship mid-plan still leaves the remaining installments due, which can be worse than not having bought the item at all.
